# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 16 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_016_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 16

**16:1** The priest said to Joseph: "Return the virgin whom you received from the temple of the Lord." Joseph burst into tears. The priest said: "I will give you the water of the Lord's conviction to drink, and it will reveal your sin to your own eyes."

**16:2** The priest prepared the water and gave it to Joseph to drink, then sent him out into the wilderness. He returned unharmed. Then the priest gave the water to Mary to drink and sent her into the wilderness as well. She also returned unharmed. All the people were astonished, because no sin had been revealed in either of them.

**16:3** The priest said: "If the Lord God has not revealed sin in you, neither shall I condemn you." And he released them both. Joseph took Mary and went back to his house, rejoicing and glorifying the God of Israel.
